svg.aria-label: A behaviour box, 45 by 30 cm, inside an enclosure 100 by 80 cm and 90 cm high, seen from the front right. An 8 mm lens fits looking down from the ceiling, a 6 mm lens from a back corner, and a 4 mm lens from the side wall. A 12 mm lens would have to be 124 cm away, outside the enclosure; from inside it, the box is cut off.
